items.note: Vanilla base with saffron and pistachio pieces.

items.name: Cassata Ice Cream
items.src: Typical Indian commercial ice-cream/dessert labels and standard recipe; cross-checked USDA and INDB
items.note: Layered ice cream with tutti-frutti and nuts.

items.name: Choco Bar (Chocolate-Coated Ice Cream Stick)
items.src: Packaged stick ice-cream labels ~220-250 kcal/100 g
items.note: Vanilla ice cream stick in a chocolate coating; about 130 kcal per 55 g bar.

items.name: Ice Cream Sundae (Hot Fudge)
items.src: Computed from vanilla ice-cream row + fudge sauce; restaurant estimate
items.note: 2 scoops vanilla, chocolate fudge sauce, nuts and a little whipped cream; about 400 kcal.

items.name: Ice Gola (Barf Ka Gola)
items.src: Computed from syrup concentration; shaved ice with 20-25 g syrup sugar per 100 g
items.note: Shaved ice with flavoured sugar syrup (about 18% sugar); contains only water and sugar. Hygiene of the ice matters.

items.name: Chocolate Mousse
items.src: USDA chocolate mousse ~200 kcal/100 g
items.note: Whipped cream, eggs and chocolate; restaurant dessert cup.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.src: USDA tiramisu ~240-280 kcal/100 g
items.note: Coffee-soaked sponge fingers with mascarpone-egg cream; cafe slice.

items.name: Rasmalai Tres Leches Cake
items.src: Computed from sponge + three-milk soak; USDA tres leches ~250 kcal/100 g
items.note: Sponge soaked in three milks (rasmalai-flavoured) with cream topping; bakery sponge normally contains eggs.

items.name: Toffee (Milk, Chewy)
items.src: Packaged toffee labels ~430-450 kcal/100 g
items.note: Packaged chewy milk toffee labels read 420-450 kcal/100 g (sugar, glucose syrup, milk, hydrogenated fat).

items.name: Hard Candy (Boiled Sweet)
items.src: Packaged hard-candy labels ~385-395 kcal/100 g
items.note: Sugar and glucose syrup only; about 390 kcal/100 g, 16 kcal per candy.
